**Spec-compliance review: PR #4 / US-01-02, round 1. Verdict: NOT COMPLIANT, one blocking item (B1).**

The code, tests and CI are in good shape. The one block is a content item: question 3p-40 is recorded as having "one unambiguous answer", but in English it has several right answers.

**CI on the head** (`b9c3d381`, run 38568166419, `Acceptance tests (Android 12 emulator)`) finished **success**. The `og-test-results` artifact holds:
- **`junit/unit.xml`:** 51 tests, 0 failures.
  - AC-01-02-1: 4 pass
  - AC-01-02-2: 4 pass
  - AC-01-02-3: 5 pass
  - AC-01-02-4: 3 pass
  - AC-01-02-5: 16 pass
  - AC-01-02-6: 3 pass
  - AC-01-02-7: 1 pass
  - The US-01-01 suites also pass.
- **`junit/release.xml`:** 7/7 pass, including "AC-01-02-7 step 2 — the release APK's embedded JavaScript bundle holds every 3+ question and answer". The local run's `release/bundle-content.txt` gives the count: 250 of 250 texts.
- **Maestro:** TC-00-01, TC-00-03, TC-01-01 and AC-01-01-4 (release, offline) all pass.
- **TC-01-02:** not in the run. DEC-44/46 defer it to US-03-01, so it is not a finding.

**Local checks on the head:** `jest --coverage` gives 15 suites and 51 tests green, with 98% line coverage on src. `tsc`, `lint` and `format:check` are all clean. In the local run, `test-runs/2026-10-14_145653/run.json` lists AC-01-02-1…7 as "skipped", but its `junit/*.xml` show them passing. US-01-01's runs show the same pattern, so the runner apparently reads only Maestro reports and run.json isn't the evidence.

## Criteria

| # | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | MET | `src/content/decks/3-plus.json` (50 questions, pl/en); `tests/unit/AC-01-02-1-50-questions-one-answer.test.ts`; CI pass |
| 2 | MET | `src/content/checks.ts:43-56`; `tests/unit/AC-01-02-2-length-limits.test.ts`; CI pass |
| 3 | MET | 13/12/13/12 per kind; `tests/unit/AC-01-02-3-four-kinds.test.ts`; CI pass |
| 4 | UNMET | Record `docs/delivery/content-checks/US-01-02-3-plus.md` is in the PR body and AC-01-02-4 passes, but the 3p-40 row records a false "One answer: pass" (B1) |
| 5 | MET | `checkDecks` returns no problems; 13 breakage cases plus duplicate id and duplicate category each make it fail; `tests/unit/AC-01-02-5-content-checks.test.ts`; CI pass |
| 6 | MET | DEC-46 path: a new category is its JSON file plus one import in `src/content/decks/index.ts`; the screen scan and the unregistered-deck test are in `tests/unit/AC-01-02-6-content-is-data.test.js`; CI pass |
| 7 | MET | AC-01-02-7 unit test plus the release-bundle check (`scripts/check-bundle-content.js`, `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:181-188`); CI pass; TC-01-02 deferred by DEC-44/46 |

## Covers

| Requirement | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F02 | MET | One deck per category; ids and categories must be unique across decks. The category label itself is not checked (N5). |
| F03 | MET | Count of 50 is checked. |
| F04 | MET | Exactly one answer is checked. |
| F05 | MET | Kinds are checked. |
| F06 | MET | Covered by the record. |
| F07 | MET | I compared all 50 pl/en pairs myself and they say the same thing. Nothing in the PR shows this check was done (N3). |
| F09 | MET | Content is in the bundle; no network code in `src/content`. |
| F10 | MET | Same evidence as criterion 6. |
| F11 | MET | Question length ≤ 100 checked. |
| F12 | MET | Answer length ≤ 60 checked. |
| F14 | NOT MET | 3p-40 (B1). |
| F15 | MET | ≥ 5 per kind checked. |

- **Edge cases:** both are implemented and tested in AC-01-02-5 step 2: counts above and below 50, a missing en answer, a missing pl question, and lengths over the limit.
- **Out of scope:** no violations. The `scripts/test-acceptance.sh` change belongs to AC-01-02-7. BACKLOG and DECISIONS changes are bookkeeping, and DEC-46 is appended only.
- **Constitution:** no violations. Content is data, no network code, and content quality is tested.
